verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy; the only deprecation-related item shows an ad hoc note that 'codex mcp-server is deprecated, use the Codex app server instead' with no formal policy, versioning scheme, or migration timeline. The API itself is noted as not yet generally available (codex-comm-5), further undercutting any claim of a stable, versioned, documented API contract.
